items.name: ByteClassElements
items.summary: An iterator over all elements in an equivalence class.

items.name: ByteClassIter
items.summary: An iterator over each equivalence class.

items.name: ByteClassRepresentatives
items.summary: An iterator over representative bytes from each equivalence class.

items.name: ByteClasses
items.summary: A representation of byte oriented equivalence classes.

methods.name: alphabet_len
methods.summary: Return the total number of elements in the alphabet represented by these equivalence classes. Equivalently, this returns the total number of equivalence classes.

methods.name: elements
methods.summary: Returns an iterator of the bytes in the given equivalence class.

methods.name: empty
methods.summary: Creates a new set of equivalence classes where all bytes are mapped to the same class.

methods.name: eoi
methods.summary: Create a unit that represents the "end of input" sentinel based on the number of equivalence classes.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: Get the equivalence class for the given byte.

methods.name: get_by_unit
methods.summary: Get the equivalence class for the given haystack unit and return the class as a `usize`.

methods.name: is_singleton
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if every byte in this class maps to its own equivalence class. Equivalently, there are 257 equivalence classes and each class contains either exactly one byte or corresponds to the singleton class containing the "e…

methods.name: iter
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over all equivalence classes in this set.

methods.name: representatives
methods.signature: fn representatives<R: core::ops::RangeBounds<u8>>(&self, range: R) -> ByteClassRepresentatives<'_>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over a sequence of representative bytes from each equivalence class within the range of bytes given.

methods.name: set
methods.signature: fn set(&mut self, byte: u8, class: u8)
methods.summary: Set the equivalence class for the given byte.

methods.name: singletons
methods.summary: Creates a new set of equivalence classes where each byte belongs to its own equivalence class.

methods.name: stride2
methods.summary: Returns the stride, as a base-2 exponent, required for these equivalence classes.

items.name: Unit
items.summary: Unit represents a single unit of haystack for DFA based regex engines.

methods.name: as_eoi
methods.summary: If this unit is an "end of input" sentinel, then return the underlying sentinel value that was given to [`Unit::eoi`]. Otherwise return `None`.

methods.name: as_u8
methods.summary: If this unit is not an "end of input" sentinel, then returns its underlying byte value. Otherwise return `None`.

methods.name: as_usize
methods.summary: Return this unit as a `usize`, regardless of whether it is a byte value or an "end of input" sentinel. In the latter case, the underlying sentinel value given to [`Unit::eoi`] is returned.

methods.name: eoi
methods.summary: Create a new "end of input" haystack unit.

methods.name: is_byte
methods.summary: Returns true if and only of this unit is a byte value equivalent to the byte given. This always returns false when this is an "end of input" sentinel.

methods.name: is_eoi
methods.summary: Returns true when this unit represents an "end of input" sentinel.

methods.name: is_word_byte
methods.summary: Returns true when this unit corresponds to an ASCII word byte.

methods.name: u8
methods.summary: Create a new haystack unit from a byte value.
